uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-3986-8201.notablePrerequisites:
You control creatures with total power 6 or greater that can attack this combat.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3986-8201.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Battle Cry Goblin as attackers.
Battle Cry Goblin triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

62-833-1362-3827.notablePrerequisites:
Soul of Windgrace can attack without taking damage.
Savage Ventmaw can attack without taking damage.
62-833-1362-3827.description:
Declare Savage Ventmaw and Soul of Windgrace as attackers.
When they attack, Savage Ventmaw and Soul of Windgrace trigger.
Resolve the Savage Ventmaw trigger, adding six mana that you will not lose this turn as steps and phases end.
Resolve the Soul of Windgrace trigger, returning Oboro, Palace in the Clouds from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Activate the last ability of Oboro, Palace in the Clouds by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
In your next main phase, cast Waves of Aggression from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {3}{R/W}{R/W} and discarding Oboro, Palace in the Clouds, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn, and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

3310-4452-7855.notablePrerequisites: You are able to put a counter on War Elemental.
3310-4452-7855.description:
Put a counter on War Elemental.
The Great Goblin's first ability triggers, as War Elemental is a Goblin, Orc or Army due to Rukarumel, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
War Elemental triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

215-955-1376.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four Elves on the battlefield.
215-955-1376.description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Priest of Titania from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Priest of Titania by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1456-5078-7650.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

328-997-3260-4078.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 10 or greater.
You have at least two opponents, or your devotion to black is at least ten.
328-997-3260-4078.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Gray Merchant.
Activate Chainer by paying 9 life due to K'rrik, returning Gray Merchant from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Nightmare in addition to its other creature types.
When Gray Merchant enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain that much life.
Repeat.
328-997-3260-4078.notes: The additional gained life can be used by Chainer to return all creature cards from all graveyards to the battlefield under your control.

1170-5195-7420-7522.description:
Cast the copy of Stream of Life from exile for X=4 by paying {4}{G}.
When you cast that spell, Molten-Core Maestro, Storm-Kiln Artist, and Displacer Kitten trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Infirmary Healer, which enters prepared.
Resolve the Molten-Core Maestro trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and adding an amount of {R} equal to its power.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding the one non-red mana you need to cast the spell from step 1.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.
Cast a copy of the prepared spell from exile by paying one mana, unpreparing Infirmary Healer // Stream of Life.
When you cast this, Displacer Kitten and Storm-Kiln Artist triggers.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten ability, flickering Infirmary Healer // Stream of Life, which enters prepared.
Resolve the remaining trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Repeat.

4907-5226-6556-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with power 4 or greater.
4907-5226-6556-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Temur Battlecrier. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

240-413-1115-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more loyalty counters on it

1170-1177-3836-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Narset by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to look at the top four cards of your library, then reveal Sensei's Divining Top and put it into your hand.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Narset.
Repeat.

930-2829-6871-6879.description:
Cast Universal Automaton by paying {1}.
When Universal Automaton enters, Haru triggers, targeting Universal Automaton as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Universal Automaton.
When Universal Automaton dies, Haru triggers, returning Universal Automaton from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Universal Automaton enters, Haru triggers, targeting Universal Automaton as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1170-1329-1492-5295.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1170-1329-1492-5295.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Welding Jar from your graveyard.
Cast Welding Jar by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1150-6797-6972.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Melira's Keepers
When Melira's Keepers dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

431-851-6441-6753.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-851-6441-6753.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

826-4508-4772-5880.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling by tapping it, causing Magmaw to gain all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

1563-2457-3000-6633.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

618-4142-6797.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Hostage Taker.
When the Hostage Taker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the Hostage Taker token.
When the Hostage Taker token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1274-2086-2292.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kitchen Finks.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1322-1563-2457-2557.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

2691-5137-5963.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
2691-5137-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Ilysian Caryatid's ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Morphling's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

5189-5332-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
5189-5332-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
Carmen's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Carmen, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2733-4050-4365-5043.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, targeting any creature you control.
Alela triggers, creating two 1/1 Faerie creature tokens with flying.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Faerie tokens, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1856-2438-4550.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
1856-2438-4550.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Doom Weaver's soulbond ability triggers, pairing it and the Zombie.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Zombie.
When the Zombie dies, it triggers, causing you to draw cards equal to its power.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

91-1365-5112-5284-5295.description:
Activate Mairsil using Cauldron of Souls' ability by tapping it, giving itself persist until end of turn.
Activate Mairsil using Blood Vassal's ability by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
When Mairsil dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Mairsil using Endling's third ability by paying {B}, giving Mairsil undying until end of turn.
Activate Mairsil using Blood Vassal's ability by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
When Mairsil dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2557-3340-3542.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six lands.
2557-3340-3542.description:
Activate six lands by tapping them, creating twelve Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate eleven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {7}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Palinchron by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Palinchron by paying {5}{U}{U}.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Repeat.

1636-1872-4331.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Drafna.
Drafna does not have summoning sickness.
1636-1872-4331.description:
Cast Composite Golem by paying {6}.
Holding priority, activate Drafna's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, copying the Composite Golem spell.
Resolve the copy of the Composite Golem spell, creating a token copy of Composite Golem.
The token Composite Golem enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Activate the token Composite Golem by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Composite Golem tokens.

224-1424-1767-5077.notablePrerequisites:
Presence of Gond attached to Scaretiller.
Scaretiller does not have summoning sickness.
224-1424-1767-5077.description:
Activate Scaretiller by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
Scaretiller triggers, returning Gateway Plaza from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Gateway Plaza enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Retreat to Coralhelm.
Resolve the Gateway Plaza trigger, choosing to sacrifice it.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Scaretiller.
Repeat.

738-1202-4659-4733.description:
Sacrifice Myr Moonvessel to Krark-Clan Ironworks, adding {C}{C}.
Myr Moonvessel and Dictate of Erebos trigger.
Resolve Myr Moonvessel's trigger, adding {C}.
Resolve Dictate of Erebos's trigger, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Glissa triggers at least once, allowing you to return Myr Moonvessel to your hand.
Cast Myr Moonvessel by paying {1}.
Repeat until your opponents no longer control any creatures.
